name: Restfox
description: Restfox exposes update-electron-app from its Electron main process and configures GitHub publishing. Its Forge packaging configuration specifies a macOS Developer ID identity and notarytool notarization, while Windows uses the Squirrel maker; the checked source does not establish whether released Windows artifacts are signed.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot at the recorded commit; update-electron-app internals and released artifact signatures were not independently audited.
